big_case.notes: Independent read, formed before weighing the candidates' scores. Public stakes are high by name recognition: the Theranos prosecution of Ramesh Balwani is among the most-covered white-collar cases of the decade. Doctrinal stakes are mid-sized and procedural: plain-error review of an unpreserved Napue claim the prosecution exploited in closing, and whether an appellate court may excuse absent Rule 702 gatekeeping on credentials alone. Either would reach every federal criminal trial if decided, but neither is a landmark. The Court denied at the first conference with the government's waiver undisturbed, no call for a response, and no separate writing (Justice Thomas took no part), which confirms low institutional salience. Mid-scale: 0.40.
